integrity: Definitions, characteristic assumptions, exact square-word fibers and image count follow from a direct group-square identity, an independent-set decomposition, and the edge-product homomorphism kernel. Computer checks are finite corroboration rather than proof.
scientific_limitations: All finite simple graphs and fields of even order only; arbitrary class-two groups and odd fields are excluded. Possible unindexed prior formulations of the same square-map fibers remain a priority risk. No independent audit.
title: Complete square-map fibers and image polynomial of characteristic-two graphical groups
